# Secure Terminal
The Secure Terminal is only to be used when genuine circumstances require it. Requests must not be submitted preemptively, speculatively, or to test the system. The conditions and examples listed are not exhaustive, and you may make requests if you believe they are in good faith.
## ERT Teams
Emergency Response Teams are called in when the station's crew is unable to handle the situation.
## Alert Levels
Alert levels for situations that do not fall into the standard alert levels.
## Armories and Pods
Deployable pods with equipment for when the station's resources are not sufficient to handle a situation.
## Misc
Other secure terminal requests that can help during emergencies.
